name: How does AKN Design Group approach air sealing within a luxury bathroom or kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group approach air sealing within a luxury bathroom or kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: In luxury bathroom or kitchen remodels, our approach to air sealing focuses on ensuring these high-traffic areas are not only aesthetically pleasing but also comfortable and efficient. When upgrading plumbing, ventilation, or electrical systems, we meticulously seal penetrations through the building envelope that could otherwise lead to drafts or moisture issues. This attention to detail, integrated into the construction process, supports the long-term integrity and performance of your new spa-inspired bathroom or functional entertaining kitchen, reflecting our commitment to craftsmanship and lasting impressions.
acceptedAnswer.description: For luxury remodels, we integrate air sealing around new systems like plumbing and ventilation to prevent drafts and moisture, ensuring comfort and long-term performance.
